source_read: https://viewthe.menu/kawv (7 menu pages re-downloaded 8 Oct: all day, kids, Big Squids, drinks, non gluten, click & collect, Deliveroo; 681 dish rows, same count as the script expects)
notes: All 205 published dishes compared with a second parser of the pages (7 nutrient cells, 14 yes/may/no allergen columns, the card's contains/may lines naming cereals and tree nuts): no extraction error. Third reading: the bold allergen words in each dish's printed ingredient list are all marked on its row (none missing; Baileys Coffee, not published, is the only dish whose bold sulphites are unmarked); no vegan/vegetarian label or non-gluten-menu dish contradicts its allergens. Held back: Feeling Fruity Cooler - Mixed Berry (printed saturates 26 g with fat 0.1 g, sugars 7 g with carbs 32 g). 116 rows with '-' (no numbers) are left out by the existing script.
